items.title: Claude Duet turns Anthropic into an agent platform
items.oneliner: Claude Duet adds 6,000 connectors and asynchronous work. Copilots are becoming delegated operators, not chat windows.

items.title: A 360M model learned terminal state transitions
items.oneliner: WorldTUI predicts terminal screens, not just text. That is a credible path toward learned software environments.

items.title: A poisoned LiteLLM release stole credentials
items.oneliner: A tampered LiteLLM package was live for two hours. Your AI stack now needs software supply chain discipline.

items.title: Railway paused deployments after a secrets incident
items.oneliner: Railway says encrypted environment variables may have been accessed. Every hosted inference workflow should rotate credentials now.

items.title: PHP2Shell was exploited before public disclosure
items.oneliner: AWS saw PHP2Shell exploitation four days before disclosure. The patch-to-exploit window is now effectively zero.

items.title: Linux kernel bugs leaked onto the public list
items.oneliner: Several Linux kernel flaws, including CVSS 9.0 issues, hit the public mailing list before fixes were ready.

items.title: The Switch 2 got a software jailbreak
items.oneliner: ns2jb breaks Switch 2 firmware 23.0.1 without hardware mods. Consumer device hardening still fails under sustained scrutiny.

items.title: Fly built a simpler block device over object storage
items.oneliner: Fly replaced filesystem complexity with a custom block device. Infrastructure teams are relearning that boring abstractions scale better.

items.title: Quad9 is leaving France over DNS blocking
items.oneliner: Quad9 will exit France rather than censor DNS. Infrastructure neutrality is now colliding directly with national courts.

items.title: eMudhra is exiting the global certificate market
items.oneliner: eMudhra is leaving the SSL and TLS certificate business. Trust infrastructure keeps consolidating around fewer operators.
